latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of editor-ai-facebook — AI-powered video editing for Facebook.

- Edit and export Facebook-ready videos from raw clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), rendered remotely at 1080p.
- Simple workflows: upload clips, describe edits, and receive finished MP4 files in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated cloud session management, including anonymous token handling if needed.
- Supports timeline editing, captions, audio tracks, and formatting for Facebook posts and ads.
- Clear user prompts and status updates; technical details handled in the background.
- Comprehensive error handling and support for credit management, session state, and export tracking.
